text:
maria.partnerships: Quick sync — kickoff for AWS/GCP/Azure listing. Need to lock demo tenant, AMI/region coverage, and legal packaging (EULA + export controls). Attached checklist below. Who can own the demo account bootstrap?

sam.cloudops: I can run the sandbox bootstrap. Need the marketplace account IDs and which regions we must seed AMIs in. Also: do we want GovCloud / Azure GOV for initial go-live?

leo.product: From product side, packaging question: do we expose a free trial SKU + paid SKU, or just trial-to-paid conversion via promo codes? Marketing prefers visible trial SKU for discoverability.

anne.legal: Legal note — for EU customers we need localized EULA + data processing addendum (DPA) tied to the SKU metadata. Also confirm whether telemetry is opt-in for trial.

maria.partnerships: Good call. Plan: (1) seed AMIs in us-east-1, eu-west-1, asia-southeast-1; (2) create demo tenant per cloud with limited quota; (3) package two SKUs: "Trial-14d" and "Standard-1vCPU". @anne.legal can you draft a short EULA addendum for trials?

anne.legal: Will do. Draft ETA: EOD tomorrow. I need the SKU descriptions and whether customer data persists after trial. If data is persisted we need retention language.

leo.product: Trial will persist data for 30 days post-trial then auto-delete unless customer upgrades. Add that to the SKU docs.

sam.cloudops: For bootstrap, here's the quick account create snippet (will run once we confirm IDs):
```bash
# create demo IAM role + bucket
aws organizations create-account --email demo+aws@example.com --account-name redwood-demo-aws
# sample AMI copy
aws ec2 copy-image --source-region us-west-2 --source-image-id ami-0abcd1234 --region us-east-1
```
I also need service principal for GCP and service principal JSON for Azure. Please drop them in the secure vault.

maria.partnerships: I'll upload the creds to vault and share ops link. Also: marketing wants a hero screenshot + 2:1 aspect hero image for the marketplace tile. @leo.product can you grab a screenshot from the staging UI?

leo.product: Yep, will export two sizes and a short 60-word blurb. Any constraints on ASCII vs Markdown in the marketplace description?

maria.partnerships: Platform accepts plain text + one markdown field. Keep the first line < 80 chars for tile.

anne.legal: Small flag — for AWS listing we must provide support contact in the contract metadata. Ensure we have a designated support email.

maria.partnerships: Support email is support+marketplace@redwood.com. I'll add that to the offer metadata.

deploy-bot: Reminder: staging AMI copy job queued — job id: jb-89234. Will notify on completion.

sam.cloudops: After AMIs are seeded I'll run basic sanity smoke: auth, inference latency < 300ms p95, billing meter hooks. Posting quick runbook for smoke checks:
1) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer demo-token" https://demo.redwood.example/v1/generate - payload: {"prompt":"ping"}
2) verify logs in cloudwatch / stackdriver / monitor
3) verify meter events reach marketplace billing webhook

maria.partnerships: Timeline: aim to have demo tenants + assets uploaded by Thu EOD so partnerships/legal/marketing can review Friday. Any blockers?

anne.legal: Need SKU wording and retention confirmation (got it from Leo). No blockers from legal once draft EULA is uploaded.

leo.product: I'll deliver hero images + SKU docs by Wed morning.

sam.cloudops: I'll schedule the AMI copies tonight and post job IDs when done.

maria.partnerships: Great—I'll circulate a one-pager and add this thread to the marketplace kickoff doc. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sam.cloudops: :+1:

leo.product: 🎯

anne.legal: :white_check_mark:
